answer.text: For solo riding, the manual gives 32 psi (2.24 kg/cm2) for the front tyre.

policy.text: Inflate the tyres to the correct air pressure.

watchouts.text: Running under-inflated tyres may make them overheat and get damaged, and may cause injury to the rider.
